Poses1/4 and3/6 are near repeats of the same stride. Toe angles change, but a complete leg exchange is not readable at native scale.
Native contact preview exposes a repeated forward-foot shuffle instead of six coherent walk phases.

preview.purpose: Private mechanical placement and visual-motion review only; contains installed original comparison pixels and is excluded from release assets.

decision: Do not register group0 or alter partial battle recipe. Review crops/GIF are not production animation. Keep group2 idle-only until a coherent walk cycle is authored.
constraint: Available reference-guided sheet generation has not yet supplied reliable professional movement, even after reducing from48 to6poses. Further action production needs a controlled pose-by-pose or rigged workflow and review; no arbitrary image deformation or idle repetition can close this gap.
